decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits at the core of the firm's water-infrastructure offer and moved up to a page of its own in 2019, so it likely meets aspirations in a growing industry and uses the firm's existing competences at little extra cost.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it reuses the firm's coating and fabrication capacity and sells to the same municipal customers, so industry growth and slack let the firm carry it despite uncertain results.

This waste-bin-with-ashtray line is a diversification into municipal street furniture that draws on existing coating and welding resources, and without clear evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, problemistic search is unlikely to target it yet.

The outdoor ashtray line belongs to the same street-furniture move and shares production and sales channels with the bins, so the firm will likely keep it while results stay ambiguous, though it is the most peripheral product and the most exposed to being dropped.
